name: tldraw
description: Draw flowcharts, architecture diagrams, wireframes and sketches on a live tldraw canvas in your browser.

interface.shortDescription: Draw diagrams on a live tldraw canvas
interface.longDescription: Codex draws on a tldraw canvas you watch at http://localhost:3030. create_diagram takes nodes and edges and does the layout itself: it sizes each box to its label, arranges layers, reduces crossings and binds the arrows, so you get a clean flowchart or architecture diagram instead of mermaid. Free-form shapes, sticky notes, frames and edits by id are supported too. Runs locally; nothing leaves your machine.
defaultPrompt: Draw this repo's architecture on the canvas
Sketch the login flow as a flowchart
Map how these modules depend on each other
